ns2:section.sectionText: Individuals registering for a laboratory section offered on Mondays must register for a laboratory-discussion section offered on Thursdays. Individuals registering for a laboratory section offered on Wednesdays must register for a laboratory-discussion section offered on Fridays. Individuals registering for a laboratory section offered on Tuesdays may register for a laboratory-discussion section offered on either Thursdays or Fridays. Enrollment in this course is restricted by major. If your program requires this course and you are unable to register for a lecture, contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.uiuc.edu for more information.
